figures.finding: Bermuda's Department of Immigration recognises the Bermuda Entertainment Union as the body representing Bermudian entertainers: every non-Bermudian entertainer is vetted by it and must hold active membership, by paying its traveller's dues, before a work permit is granted, and a Bermudian act must be hired beside each foreign one.

value.joinNonBermudian: active membership by payment of traveller's dues, before a work permit

figures.applies: Entertainers and support staff providing entertainment services in Bermuda, by the Entertainment Policy effective 30 July 2018; the policy names no film or television work and sets no pay.

sources.said: All entertainers and support staff must be first vetted through the Bermuda Entertainment Union, prior to any processing of a work permit by the Department of Immigration. … Persons requiring work permits are required to have active membership (by way of payment of traveler’s dues) with the Bermuda Entertainment Union before work permits will be granted. … The local group, the body recognized as representing Bermudian entertainers, (i.e.; the Bermuda Entertainment Union)
